# Wispel

> Wispel is a free gamification app for Dutch families: children earn points for
> homework and household chores, parents manage tasks and rewards. iOS + web.

- Free for families. No subscription, no trial paywall, no feature paywall on
  core functionality. Sustained by optional, parent-only donations — never
  shown to children.
- Privacy first: no ads, no third-party trackers or ad SDKs in the child
  experience, EU-hosted (Cloudflare Workers, D1, R2 — EU regions), photos are
  EXIF-stripped and deleted after 30 days.
- No AI in the product today. If an AI feature ever ships, it stays
  parent-facing or safety-facing only: never a chatbot for children, never
  child-identifying data in a model prompt, opt-in and off by default. See
  /privacy for the current, authoritative statement.
- Not a Kids Category app — it is a family app used by parents and children
  together, with a parent-only settings area (parental gate) and no data
  shared with third parties without disclosure.

## Pages

- [Privacy](https://wispel.cc/nl/privacy): what data we collect, why, where it
  lives, and our AI policy — in plain Dutch and English.
- [Terms](https://wispel.cc/nl/voorwaarden): terms of use.
- [Support Wispel](https://wispel.cc/nl/steun): optional parent donations.
